note: Unresolved founder-doc values stay unset. Do not ship a guessed rule as fact.

sessionAccess.note: Trainer and student may enter the shared room from ten minutes before the scheduled start. Founder entry requires an explicit observer request that is visible to both participants.

sessionTiming.note: The room clock starts when verified trainer presence begins. The pay window is -01:00 to +59:00 from the scheduled start; the trainer must complete 50 active teaching minutes inside it. Reconnects pause and resume the active timer.

regular.note: Full pay requires 50 active teaching minutes inside the -01:00 to +59:00 window. Late-join bands apply only when the child joins; trainer-only sessions pay after 15 counted minutes. Extra full minutes from 50 to 55 add 5 INR only while the child is still present and the 35-minute child gate is met.

demo.note: A demo has the same 50-minute teaching requirement, five-minute warning, 55-minute server close, pay rate, late/fine bands and child pay gate as a regular class.

lifetime.note: Demo and regular classes both warn at 50 and close at 55 with the same base rate, late bands and fine policy. Timers run from the trainer's verified class clock, and the browser never owns the close.

trainerSlots.note: A declared slot is committed to that trainer. Classes inside it are paid at 100%; unutilised hours are paid at 30% of the trainer's session rate.

presence.payGateNote: With the child present, trainer pay unlocks only after the child has 35 counted minutes and the trainer has 50 active teaching minutes. Without the child, 15 counted trainer minutes are enough.

networkCheck.note: A 1:1 video class stays closed until both verified participants pass a fresh connection check. 15 Mbps down, 10 Mbps up and <=250 ms latency are the minimum floors for a smooth lesson; a passing result expires after 15 minutes.

payout.demoPayNote: Demo sessions use the same pay rate, 50-minute duration, 50-55 stretch and late/fine bands as regular classes.

founderGratitude.label: Founder’s Gratitude Gift
founderGratitude.note: Founder’s Gratitude Gift: ₹2,000 is credited to every trainer’s balance sheet on the first day of each month as a standing, non-revocable acknowledgement of faithful service, steady reliability, and the hard work they bring to every child’s learning. This credit is protected from deductions, cancellations and reversals, and may be adjusted only by the founder.

shortTrainerPresence.note: When the child does not join, the trainer still needs 15 counted minutes. Below that there is no pay and one session-pay is charged. Late-join bands only apply when the child is present.

studentPayGateFine.note: When the child joins but stays under 35 counted minutes, trainer pay is blocked and one session-pay is charged; the late fine is suppressed for that session so no double fine is applied.

stretchReward.note: Each full active teaching minute beyond 50 and up to 55 adds 5 INR for both demos and regular classes, only while the child is still in the session and the child's 35-minute pay gate is met.

parentPack.note: SAR-only parent session packs. The 5% discount starts at 41 sessions; a 40-session bulk pack is not discounted. Trainer pay stays INR and is untouched by this policy.
